title: Interpretable Aging Signatures in Human Retinal Cell Types Revealed by Single-Cell RNA Sequencing and Sparse Logistic Regression.
authors: Yang, Luning; Lin, Sen; Tao, Yiwen; Pan, Qi; Cai, Tengda; Ye, Yunyan; Liu, Jianhui; Zhou, Yang; Shao, Yongqing; Yi, Quanyong; Lu, Zen Huat; Chen, Lie; McKay, Gareth; Rankin, Richard; Li, Fan; Meng, Weihua
one_liner_zh: 该文用单细胞RNA测序和稀疏逻辑回归构建视网膜细胞衰老分类器，虽涉及转录因子调控网络映射，但核心是细胞衰老转录组分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: PURPOSE: To characterize cell-type-specific transcriptional changes during human retinal aging and develop machine learning (ML) model for cellular age discrimination in a Chinese cohort. DESIGN: Cross-sectional, laboratory-based observational study. PARTICIPANTS: Eighteen unfrozen retinas from 12 Chinese donors (9 young, 34-55 y; 9 old, 68-92 y). METHODS: Single-cell RNA sequencing (10x, v3.1) generated 223 612 cells, batch-corrected with single-cell variational inference; age-related signatures were defined by intersecting single-cell and pseudobulk differentially expressed genes (DEGs), then cell-type-specific panels were rank-ordered with L1-regularized logistic regression plus recursive feature elimination and interpreted through hallmark-pathway enrichment and transcription factor (TF) regulon mapping. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Age-related cellular composition shifts; cell-type-specific DEGs; ML classifier accuracy and feature rankings; TF regulon activity changes. RESULTS: Eleven major retinal cell populations were identified. Aging showed declining rod-to-cone ratios, reduced bipolar cell (BC) proportions among interneurons, and increased astrocyte abundance. Muller glial cells exhibited the most pronounced transcriptional changes, followed by BCs and rods. Machine learning classifiers achieved 80% to 96% accuracy across cell types (microglia 96%, horizontal cells [HCs] 93%, BCs 91%, cones 90%, rods 89%). Shared aging signatures included mitochondrial dysfunction and inflammatory activation. Cell-specific vulnerabilities emerged: mitochondria-centric stress in rods/BCs, proteostasis-retinoid metabolism in cones, and structural-RNA maintenance in HCs. CONCLUSIONS: This study provides the first ML derived, cell-type-specific aging signatures for human retina in a Chinese cohort, revealing both conserved molecular hallmarks and distinctive cellular vulnerabilities that inform targeted therapeutic strategies for retinal aging. FINANCIAL DISCLOSURES: The author has no/the authors have no proprietary or commercial interest in any materials discussed in this article.
abstract_zh: 目的：表征人类视网膜老化过程中细胞类型特异性的转录变化，并在中国队列中开发用于细胞年龄判别的机器学习（ML）模型。设计：横断面、基于实验室的观察性研究。参与者：来自12名中国捐赠者的18个未冷冻视网膜（9名年轻，34-55岁；9名老年，68-92岁）。方法：单细胞RNA测序（10x，v3.1）生成223 612个细胞，通过单细胞变分推断进行批次校正；年龄相关特征通过交集单细胞和伪批量差异表达基因（DEGs）定义，随后使用L1正则化逻辑回归结合递归特征消除对细胞类型特异性面板进行排序，并通过标志性通路富集和转录因子（TF）调控子映射进行解释。主要结局指标：年龄相关的细胞组成变化；细胞类型特异性DEGs；ML分类器准确性和特征排名；TF调控子活性变化。结果：识别出11种主要视网膜细胞群体。老化显示视杆细胞与视锥细胞比例下降，中间神经元中双极细胞（BC）比例减少，星形胶质细胞丰度增加。Müller胶质细胞表现出最显著的转录变化，其次是BCs和视杆细胞。机器学习分类器在各细胞类型中达到80%至96%的准确率（小胶质细胞96%，水平细胞[HCs] 93%，BCs 91%，视锥细胞90%，视杆细胞89%）。共享老化特征包括线粒体功能障碍和炎症激活。细胞特异性脆弱性显现：视杆细胞/BCs中的线粒体中心应激，视锥细胞中的蛋白质稳态-视黄醇代谢，以及HCs中的结构-RNA维持。结论：本研究提供了首个基于ML的中国队列人类视网膜细胞类型特异性老化特征，揭示了保守的分子标志和独特的细胞脆弱性，为视网膜老化的靶向治疗策略提供信息。财务披露：作者在本文讨论的任何材料中无/作者无专有或商业利益。
